Improved reload and range.

  •  Slightly increases range

  •  Increases range

perks.name: Tactical Mag

This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Drop Mag

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.desc: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Meganeura
perks.desc: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of rapid precision hits dealt beforehand.

perks.name: Supercharged Magazine
perks.desc:
While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine. 

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Trickle Charge
perks.desc: Receiving or discharging Bolt Charge partially loads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.desc: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.desc: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.desc: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

perks.name: Tex Balanced Stock
perks.desc: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Gravity Well
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon automatically gathers nearby ammo.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 139 from 13 May 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0m6Sfdv88fNZmYm9A6PdVR?si=140d643338154357) with @ImpetusAlways @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Unfortunately, Terminus Horizon is in the weakest subfamily for damage, so you can pass if you already have a well-rolled arc LMG. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good - d2foundry.gg calculates that 64 Range equates to 47.88m ADS and 29.93m hipfire before damage dropoff, 25 Stability is ×1.1112 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 38 Handling is 0.40s ready, 0.41s ADS and 0.38s stow speed, 24 Reload Speed is a 5.44s reload, Recoil Direction is 74, Zoom is 17, and magazine size is 46 (max 73). With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo is 382/427/472/495 (max 495). A little bit of Stability and Handling from the barrel perk are useful to improve gunfeel and control. For the magazine perk, pretty much any is useable, except maybe Extended Mag. You might use this with double special as a heavy pseudo-scout rifle for general add clearing, in which case the double damage perks of Dragonfly for an arc AoE explosion on a crit kill, and Killing Tally for up to ×1.3 damage after three kills for as long as you don't reload or stow.The Tex Balanced Stock is there if you like hipfiring, but the Gravity Well origin trait can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload. Recommended MW: Handling, Stability or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Ionic Traces or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Yeehaw, the Terminus Horizon is back to round out our rodeo! With new Arc perks as well as the ever-powerful Reconstruction + Killing Tally, there's some solid choices for this High-Impact Machine Gun. I'm particularly looking forward to trying out Triple Tap and Precision Instrument to see how that plays together. This archetype does suffer from an abysmal reload speed and stability, so fix those as you can." Recommended MW: Stability or Reload Speed

warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Terminus Horizon is a weapon that has PvP potential, it just has some hurdles to overcome. Once you deal with the Stability, you should have an easier time landing shots and that's where the perks come in. Pick your favorite 3rd column perk (Eddy Current seems like a strong option) and damage bonus and you're in business. Of special note, Killing Tally can 3 crit all Resilience levels at 3 stacks (a jaw dropping 0.33s ttk )@" Recommended MW: Range or Stability

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Terminus Horizon will be an interesting weapon to use. Being a slow firing weapon it can probably take advantage of target lock better than the other archetypes purely because the weapon takes longer to empty its magazine comparatively. Having 73 bullets at maximum capacity and laying into a boss with triple tap, demolitionist for instant reloads or rapid hit for the bonuses to stability and reload. There are few times I will fully recommend a high-impact machine gun, but Terminus Horizon is definitely one of them.." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Terminus Horizon will also fare pretty well in the crucible. Having access to high-impact reserves for some bonus damage or cascade point for an almost desperado type RPM increase will feel incredible depending on your streak or preference. Try and bump up its stability to make sure you can hit every single shot." Recommended MW - Range.
